name: Otto Suwen
japaneseName: オットー・スーウェン
description: Otto Suwen is a former traveling merchant and the indispensable internal affairs officer of the Emilia Camp. First crossing paths with Subaru during the White Whale conflict in Arc 3, he cemented his status as Subaru's first true friend in the fantasy world by confronting Garfiel in Arc 4, subsequently handling the camp's administrative, political, and logistical affairs.
